chapters.title: Chapter 1: Retries Are Amplifiers in Disguise
chapters.core_question: Why do naive retry loops turn brief network blips into total cluster outages?
chapters.key_takeaway: Unbounded retries multiply load exactly when downstream capacity is lowest.

chapters.title: Chapter 2: Queues Never Create Capacity
chapters.core_question: When does adding a queue improve throughput versus merely delaying failure?
chapters.key_takeaway: Unbounded queues convert transient spikes into universal timeout storms.

chapters.title: Chapter 3: Bulkheads and Graceful Fallbacks
chapters.core_question: How do we isolate secondary feature failures from core checkout paths?
chapters.key_takeaway: Separate connection pools keep optional widgets from starving primary transactions.

chapters.title: Chapter 4: Game Days That Actually Teach
chapters.core_question: How do engineering teams verify recovery procedures before 3 a.m.?
chapters.key_takeaway: Untested runbooks decay within a single quarter.
